findings.title: ForTenant ignores the tenant filter and leaks other tenants' invoices
findings.detail: billing/invoices.go: ForTenant returns the entire invoices slice regardless of tenantID, leaking other tenants' data.

findings.title: Summarize also leaks invoices across tenants
findings.detail: billing/report.go: Summarize ranges over the same package-level invoices slice, so it can leak other tenants' data too.

summary: Two leaks found, one of them a false alarm on Summarize.
